name: Codihi Quick Edit
author: Codihi

sections.description:
On the WooCommerce Products list, “Quick Edit” opens a pop-up instead of squeezing the form into the table row.

Out of the box

Exactly the fields of the native Quick Edit: title, slug, status, reviews, catalog visibility, featured, categories, tags, SKU, prices, tax, stock, backorders, weight, dimensions and shipping class.

Turn on as many more as you need (Codihi Plugins → Quick Edit → Fields)

  • Short description and description (WordPress visual editor with Add Media)
  • Product image and gallery
  • Sale price schedule, publish date, password, menu order
  • GTIN / UPC / EAN, low stock threshold, sold individually
  • Upsells and cross-sells (WooCommerce product search)
  • Variations table: enabled, SKU, regular/sale price, stock per variation, “apply to all”
  • Virtual, downloadable, purchase note
  • Brands and every other product taxonomy (WooCommerce Brands, Perfect Brands …)
  • SEO title, meta description and focus keyword (Yoast SEO or Rank Math)
  • Your own custom fields: any product meta key as text, long text, number, yes/no, drop-down, date or link

Fields that do not apply to a product are hidden automatically (e.g. no regular price on a variable product, no stock quantity while stock tracking is off).

Arrange the pop-up your way

  • Every section can be dragged to a new place, moved up or down with the arrow buttons, collapsed, or hidden — like the boxes of the WordPress editor.
  • The Sections button in the pop-up header lists all sections: reorder them, hide them and bring them back.
  • Your arrangement is remembered per user.
  • Categories, brands and other term lists show what is already selected first.

Safe by design

  • Only the fields you changed are sent and saved.
  • All-or-nothing: if one field is invalid (duplicate SKU, sale price above the regular price …) nothing is written and the field is highlighted.
  • If someone else changed the product after you opened it, you are asked before anything is overwritten.
  • Every save goes through the WooCommerce product API, so stock sync, price caches, lookup tables and other plugins’ hooks keep working.
  • Per-product permission checks; descriptions are filtered for users without the unfiltered_html capability.

Fast to work with

  • The product’s row in the list refreshes in place after saving — no page reload.
  • Save & next walks down the list; previous/next arrows; double-click a row to open it.
  • Light, dark or automatic theme; one-page or tabbed layout; up to full screen.
  • Ctrl+S saves, Esc closes (with a warning if you have unsaved changes).
  • “Next to Quick Edit” mode keeps the native inline Quick Edit and adds a “Pop-up edit” link instead.

For developers

  • Filter codihi_qe_fields — add, change or remove pop-up fields (see includes/class-codihi-qe-fields.php).
  • Filters codihi_qe_builtin_fields (fields that can be switched on in Settings), codihi_qe_groups (sections), codihi_qe_enabled_fields (final list for the current user), codihi_qe_payload and codihi_qe_popup_config.
  • Actions codihi_qe_before_save( $product, $changes, $args ) and codihi_qe_product_saved( $product, $changed_keys, $args ).
  • Actions codihi_qe_enqueue_popup, codihi_qe_enqueue_settings, codihi_qe_settings_tabs and codihi_qe_settings_panels for add-ons.
  • JavaScript: the window.codihiQEApi object (custom field types, field filters, header buttons) and the jQuery event codihi_qe_saved on document after every save.

Documentation

A step-by-step setup guide covers the fields, custom fields, keyboard shortcuts and troubleshooting. It is also available in Greek.

Codihi Plugins menu

Adds (or joins) the shared Codihi Plugins admin menu. Its Overview page lists the Codihi plugins installed on your site with links to their settings, and the plugins available on codihi.com. Nothing is shown outside wp-admin.

Codihi Quick Edit Pro

Codihi Quick Edit Pro is distributed from codihi.com with a license key for automatic updates and support. On top of everything above it adds: change history with one-click undo, field restrictions per user role, field profiles, bulk editing in the pop-up with percentage and rounding rules, price tools, editing of attributes, downloadable files and external / grouped products, ACF fields, and switching between WPML / Polylang translations. If both plugins are active, the free one pauses itself.

External services

Codihi product catalog (codihi.com)

When an administrator opens the “Codihi Plugins” overview page in wp-admin, the plugin requests the public product list from https://codihi.com/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products to show the other Codihi plugins with their prices. It is a plain GET request: no store, customer, user or product data is sent, and the result is cached for 12 hours (the “Refresh” link requests it again). If codihi.com cannot be reached, a built-in list without prices is shown instead. Nothing is requested from codihi.com on any other page or on the front end, and the pop-up editor itself never contacts any external service.

This service is provided by Codihi: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then upload the codihi-quick-edit folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Go to Products and click Quick Edit under any product.
  3. Choose more fields under Codihi Plugins → Quick Edit.
sections.faq:
Can I still use WooCommerce’s own Quick Edit?

Yes — set Behaviour → How the pop-up opens to “Next to Quick Edit”.

Does Bulk Edit change?

No. WooCommerce’s own Bulk Edit (several products at once) stays as it is.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Enable the Variations field to edit enabled state, SKU, prices and stock of every variation in the pop-up.

Can I change the order of the sections or hide some of them?

Yes. Drag a section by its handle, use the arrow buttons in its header, or open the Sections button in the pop-up header. Sections can also be collapsed or hidden and brought back from the same menu. The arrangement is saved per user.

Is any product data lost when I uninstall?

No. Uninstalling removes only the plugin’s own settings and the saved section arrangements; everything saved to your products stays.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2 — 2026-10-25

  • Clean package: only the plugin’s own files are included (a leftover temporary file and old files from an earlier build are gone). This edition contains no license or update code and contacts no server other than the one listed under “External services”.

1.3.1 — 2026-10-19

  • Security hardening: the data sent by the pop-up is sanitized as soon as it is received, before any hook sees it.
  • Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org (the bundled translation files and the textdomain loader were removed).
  • Admin notices of this plugin only appear on the Plugins screen.

1.3.0 — 2026-10-16

  • New: drag & drop the sections of the pop-up, move them up or down with arrow buttons, collapse or hide them, and manage them from the Sections menu. The arrangement is remembered per user.
  • New: categories, brands and other term lists show the selected terms first.
  • New: developer hooks for add-ons (see “For developers”).
  • The saving code is now reusable (Codihi_QE_Ajax::apply_changes()).

1.2.0 — 2026-10-16

  • Prepared for WordPress.org: the license key and the custom update checker were removed from this edition; updates now come from WordPress.org.
  • Pauses itself when Codihi Quick Edit Pro is active.
  • “Requires Plugins: woocommerce” header added.

1.1.0 — 2026-10-02

  • One-page layout: every section at once in columns (switchable back to tabs), with a chip bar to jump between sections.
  • Light, dark or automatic theme — switchable from the pop-up header.
  • Full-screen size and a full-screen button; compact density by default (comfortable optional).

1.0.0 — 2026-10-02

  • First release.
